requirementCueLines: UNIVERSITY MINIMUM ADMISSIONS REQUIREMENTS
Transfer applicants must meet the following minimum requirements to be considered for admissions:
Completion of CADR or core subject requirements if applicant has fewer than 40 transferrable credits (see below) at the time of application.
Proof of English language proficiency (if required) .
MAJOR ADMISSION REQUIREMENTS

This is a minimum- requirements major , meaning that students who meet the general admission requirements and minimum GPA in each prerequisite course are eligible for review for entry into the program .
Applicants to Data Visualization (BA) must complete these prerequisites:
English Composition
BWRIT 134
Advanced English Composition or Technical Writing
ENGL 141
BWRIT 135
MATH 120
BMATH 122 & BMATH 123
STAT 220 or equivalent
BIS 215, B BUS 215, B MATH 215, or equivalent
Prerequisite GPA of 2.70
All prerequisites complete at time of application

Please fill out this form and attach your unofficial college transcripts if you want a transfer admissions counselor to check for prerequisite course equivalencies. Please note that if the colleges you attended are not part of the Washington State Community & Technical College system , we might need to request additional documentation like course syllabi to determine equivalency.

School of IAS Requirements & Policies
Residency Requirement: 30 credits must be completed in residency at UW Bothell.

Interdisciplinary Practice & Reflection (IPR): The IPR requirement can overlap with credits earned in major coursework, or it can be completed through elective course credits. Please see the IPR webpage for course options.

Upper Division Credit Policy: A maximum of 35 credits earned in 100- and/or 200-level courses may apply toward the Bachelor of Arts degree. A maximum of 45 credits earned in 100- and/or 200-level courses may apply toward the Bachelor of Science degree. Remaining credits must be earned in upper division courses (300-level and above).
